subject: Skyward AI — POC kickoff & capacity sync
messages:
From: Sam Liu <sam.liu@skyward.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Goodwin <j.goodwin@cloudops.co>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Skyward POC kickoff & capacity sync

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’re ready to kick off a short POC to validate routing behavior and token economics for a customer-facing assistant. High level ask: a 2‑week hands-on POC with a kickoff + one load-test session in week two.

Can we schedule a 60–90 minute kickoff next week to cover: prompt review, routing policy options (fallbacks to smaller variants), and a capacity plan (Dedicated vs Hosted trial, quota bumps, token budgets)?

Availability windows (PST):
- Tue 1/12, 11:00–13:00
- Wed 1/13, 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Thu 1/14, 10:00–12:00

Also, two quick asks in advance so we can shape the agenda:
1) Can Redwood outline typical hosted quota bump process and expected lead time?
2) We’ll need guidance on token budgeting for our worst-case prompt (expected 1.2k tokens average, spikes to ~6k).

Attaching a short POC requirements spreadsheet.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Liu
Head of Integrations, Skyward AI
--- Attachment: skyward_poc_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Liu <sam.liu@skyward.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Skyward POC kickoff & capacity sync

Sam — thanks, this looks good. Monica (solutions) and Jordan (CS) are looped to cover runtime and load planning.

We can do 90 minutes to fit both technical and capacity discussions. Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 1/12, 11:00–12:30 (works for us)
- Wed 1/13, 14:00–15:30 if you prefer afternoon

Quick answers to your pre-asks:
- Hosted quota bumps: we can usually approve non-production quota increases within 48–72 hours for POCs, production bumps require contract/commit and take longer. We’ll confirm exact numbers after triage.
- Token budgeting: helpful if you can share a few representative prompts. For a worst-case 6k spike, we’ll want to discuss batching and KV cache strategies to avoid cost blowouts; Monica can sketch options during the kickoff.

Agenda draft:
1) Intros & goals (10m)
2) Prompt review / representative flows (20m)
3) Routing/fallback strategy (15m)
4) Capacity planning (Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs) (20m)
5) Load-test plan & schedule (15m)
6) Action items & timelines (10m)

Monica — can you bring a short checklist (network egress, VPC options, rate-limit knobs) and the load-test template?

Sam — I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm the slot.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Sam Liu <sam.liu@skyward.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Skyward POC kickoff & capacity sync — agenda + checklist

Karthik / Sam — adding a few concrete prep items and attachments so we can hit the ground running.

I’ll present the quick checklist and the load-test approach. Attached: redwood_poc_checklist.docx and a network diagram template we often ask customers to fill out.

Pre-reads I’d appreciate (small list):
- 2–3 representative prompts (include typical system + user fragments)
- A sample peak-concurrency estimate (tokens/sessions) for your expected traffic during test windows

Notes on capacity tradeoffs (short):
- Hosted trial: fastest to start, quota bumpable for POCs, predictable ops. Limited if you need a private VPC or sustained high-throughput.
- Dedicated: required for steady high throughput (SLA, private capacity), longer lead time and minimum commit. We can do short-term dedicated proof-of-concept but pricing/commit will differ.

Load-test template highlights:
- Test window timing (we typically run 15–30m bursts at 2x expected concurrency)
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 450ms for text-gen baseline, token-cost variance within +/- 15% of forecast

Attachments: redwood_poc_checklist.docx (7KB), network_diagram.pdf (120KB)

— Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
--- Attachments: redwood_poc_checklist.docx, network_diagram.pdf

Thanks — quick update: we have an internal product all-hands that conflicts with Tue 1/12 11:00–12:30. Can we move to Wed 1/13, 14:00–15:30 as you suggested? That slot should work for Jordan Goodwin (our infra lead) as well.

A couple of clarifications before the call:
- For hosted quota bumps, are there any hard upper limits we should know about for burst traffic (e.g., per-minute token caps)?
- We’ll upload two representative prompts and a short concurrency estimate to the Drive link before EOD.

Also, can Redwood confirm whether a temporary VPC peering or IP allowlist is sufficient for the POC, or if we need a short-lived dedicated deployment? Jordan Goodwin will bring the security view.

Sam
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Liu <sam.liu@skyward.ai>, Jordan Goodwin <j.goodwin@cloudops.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-12T15:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Skyward POC kickoff & capacity sync — confirmed

Wed 1/13, 14:00–15:30 PST confirmed. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=skyward-poc-kickoff

Quick answers / action items before the meeting:
1) Hosted burst caps: nominally we operate with per-tenant rate limits; for POCs we can apply a temporary elevation to support short bursts (we typically allow up to 1.5M tokens/day for a POC after a triage and manual approval; per-minute caps apply but can be increased for scheduled load tests). We’ll surface exact numbers in the kickoff.
2) VPC & security: temporary IP allowlist or peering is usually sufficient for hosted trials. If you need private networking for compliance, we can scope a short-lived Dedicated node but that will require engineering lead time.
3) Please upload the representative prompts and concurrency estimate to the Drive link in related_links; Monica will review pre-reads.

Planned attendees from Redwood: Karthik, Monica, Jordan Blake (CS). From Skyward: Sam Liu, Jordan Goodwin (infra).

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/HW-2391-SKY — I’ll log the quota bump request there so our ops team has the ticket.

See you Wed.

— Karthik
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
